== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Bastion]]'s [[Shadow]] is a massive [[Navigator]]'s [[Vessel]] utilized by the [[Consultants]]. Constructed from seamless black wood, the ship is significantly larger than other vessels like [[The Testament]] and possesses the capability to travel through the [[Aion]]. A defining feature of the ship is a large, prominent eye located at the top of its mast; this eye, which appears in various colors such as black-and-gold or yellow, functions as a crow's nest and can swivel to scan the surrounding environment. The ship is known for its impressive maneuverability, as its captain can navigate through dense fields of gravity-defying debris and floating masonry at high speeds. While intended to operate under the cover of [[Bastion's Veil]] for secrecy, the vessel has been seen sailing exposed during times when the protective mist was depleted or collapsed.}}
